    Restricting Π of a tree to a full subtree #

    The argument of SubstarRestriction for any embedding f : Δ' → Δ of oriented trees that preserves and reflects adjacency and orientation: the restriction res maps the ideal of Π(Δ) with the outside of the image deleted into the ideal of Π(Δ') (res_mem), so nonzero paths of Π(Δ') stay nonzero (not_mem_del). We use it for intervals in the middle of a path (Appendix B, odd quotients of even A: "retain the first (r+1)/2 levels").

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
